Origin and meaning

Amelia is a Germanic name meaning “industrious, striving”.

About the name Amelia

A name with aviation history through the pilot Amelia Earhart.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Amelia carries the meaning “industrious, striving” and looks striking in brush strokes.
